purpose: Define what must be true before MarketsGPT may be described as a trade engine that can be relied upon for real-money execution decisions.
requiredBeforeRelianceClaim: Frozen complete trade-construction engine passes development.
Purged/embargoed walk-forward validation passes without rule changes.
Fresh out-of-sample validation passes under realistic costs and slippage.
One-shot sealed holdout passes with no rescue.
Independent provider/execution replication passes for each promoted market family.
Forward shadow period confirms signal generation, timestamps, data freshness and execution assumptions.
Calibration is demonstrated for any probability/confidence field.
Missed-opportunity audit demonstrates acceptable recall without precision collapse.
Tail-loss, drawdown, concentration and correlation limits pass.
Broker order submission remains disabled until a separate execution-safety gate is explicitly opened.
permittedCurrentDescription: Institutional research and decision-support program under validation above the frozen R15 product baseline.
